jobs.title: Threat intelligence and public monitoring
jobs.decision: An employee credential appears in an external dataset. Does it belong to an active identity, and does it warrant an investigation?
jobs.proof: Match the observation to the identity and exposure date. Review sign-ins or sessions before drawing a conclusion about use.

options.label: GitGuardian Public Monitoring for a leaked machine credential

jobs.title: Security data pipelines
jobs.decision: The identity team has sign-in events, but the SOC cannot find them in its search tool. Are events reaching the right destination with the necessary fields?
jobs.proof: Trace a sample event from source to destination. Compare timestamps, identity fields, delivery counts and retention. A missing log can leave an investigation inconclusive.

jobs.title: Detection engineering
jobs.decision: A logging change renamed the field that identifies the principal. Will the team's rule still alert on the intended activity?
jobs.proof: Exercise the rule on a synthetic event expected to alert and a benign event expected to pass. Check the deployed rule against the fields actually reaching the SOC.

jobs.title: Endpoint and cross-domain detection (EDR and XDR)
jobs.decision: An employee's laptop alert and a cloud finding appear in the same hour. Is there evidence tying the device, user and cloud session together?
jobs.proof: Build a timeline with the identifiers and timestamps the two records share. Record which events could belong to different users or sessions.

options.label: CrowdStrike Falcon Insight XDR for device and identity telemetry
AWS Security Hub for cloud exposure context

jobs.title: Security analytics and the investigation queue (SIEM)
jobs.decision: AppSec and cloud security both opened a ticket about a leaked key. Where will the SOC keep one investigation, its timeline and the evidence behind the decision?
jobs.proof: Walk one finding into an assigned case. Show the source record, the analyst's conclusion, the unresolved questions and the handoff to the credential owner.

jobs.title: Response playbooks and automation (SOAR)
jobs.owner: SOC automation engineering and the owner of the affected system
jobs.decision: The SOC wants to automate enrichment and ticket assignment. Which actions can run unattended, and who can authorize an access change that could stop a production job?
jobs.proof: Trace one finding through the configured trigger, any required approval and the action result. Check the target system and record how a failed or repeated action is handled.

jobs.title: Managed detection and incident response
jobs.owner: CISO or SOC director, managed provider and on-call service owner
jobs.decision: An incident arrives after hours. Who investigates, whom can the provider page, and which containment actions has the customer authorized?
jobs.proof: Use an agreed tabletop scenario. Check the contract, enrolled assets, escalation timeline, allowed actions and who confirms recovery. Compare providers against the same service scope.

options.label: Rapid7 MDR with optional Active Response
AWS Security Incident Response with Proactive Response

adjacent.label: Application security
adjacent.job: Find the publishing path that exposed a secret and fix the build or repository workflow.

adjacent.label: Identity security
adjacent.job: Identify the principal, retire the compromised credential and account for sessions already issued.

adjacent.label: Cloud security
adjacent.job: Identify the workload, weigh its exposure and verify the cloud configuration after a fix.

adjacent.label: Data security
adjacent.job: Determine what sensitive data was reachable and what retained records show was accessed.

adjacent.label: Corporate IT and endpoint security
adjacent.job: Check the employee device and coordinate any isolation with the service desk.

adjacent.label: Governance, risk and compliance
adjacent.job: Document the decision, accountable owner, evidence and any remaining risk.

adjacent.label: Cyber recovery
adjacent.job: Restore affected business services and verify with the service owner that they work.
